nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117‑3.3 LDO steps VIN_5V down to VCC_3V3 (3.3 V) for digital logic. The LDO is always enabled (CE tied to VIN). This module supplies the MCU and DAC power rail. Bypass caps are required at VIN and VOUT pins but are not represented here.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: ATmega328P provides I2C master functionality to program the MCP4725 DAC. It is powered from VCC_3V3 supplied by the 3.3 V LDO. I2C clock (SCL) is driven by the MCU (Output) while SDA is a bi‑directional open‑drain line shared with the DAC. No external crystal or boot‑mode pins are required for this design.

nodes.name: dac
nodes.description: MCP4725 12‑bit I2C DAC generates a programmable bias voltage (VOUT) for the NE5532 non‑inverting input network. It operates from the same 3.3 V rail as the MCU. The I2C pins are slaves (SCL Input, SDA Bi‑directional). A0 pin is left unconnected, giving the default I2C address.

nodes.name: VOUT
nodes.description: DAC analog output, rail-to-rail (0 to VDD).

nodes.name: VDD
nodes.description: Supply voltage (2.7-5.5V), also serves as DAC reference.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: SCL
nodes.description: I2C clock, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: I2C address bit. VSS=0x60, VDD=0x61. Must not float.

nodes.name: amp
nodes.description: NE5532 dual op‑amp used only channel‑1 as a non‑inverting audio pre‑amplifier. Positive supply VCC_P is tied to VIN_5V; negative supply VCC_N is tied to GND. The DAC bias voltage feeds the non‑inverting (+) input via the BIAS_VOLTAGE port. The amplified audio is presented on AUDIO_OUT. Channel‑2 inputs are tied to a safe bias and its output is left unused.
